finding.guards_checked: SessionMiddleware (server/internal/routes/router/sessionMiddleware.go:22-35, game.go:285) only requires a valid session, not ownership. Contrast updateTags.go:61-65, which does enforce UnsafeGetHostId()==sess.GetUserId(), so the omission here is inconsistent with the codebase. finding.claim: The PlayFab LoginWithSteam endpoint never verifies the Steam ticket. It parses a SteamID out of attacker-supplied hex and issues a session for whichever user has that platform ID. The Authentication setting is not applied to this route, so this bypasses the official-server verification that 'required' and 'cached' are meant to enforce.
finding.source: Request body SteamTicket (loginWithSteamRequest.SteamTicket, LoginWithSteam.go:38-40). The route is anonymous.
finding.sink: sessions.CreateWithSteamUserId(game.Users(), steamId) (models/playfab/session.go:54-60) issues a session and entity token for the target user. Those tokens authorize GetPlayerCombinedInfo, GetUserReadOnlyData, Inventory, CloudScript ExecuteFunction, and so on.

trace.note: POST /Client/LoginWithSteam registered (AoM only)
/Client/LoginWithSteam is in playAnonymousPaths, so no session or token is required
LoginWithSteam handler
ParseSteamIDHex(req.SteamTicket), with no signature or ownership verification
Parses the length/version/steamID fields only; no cryptographic check
CreateWithSteamUserId returns a session for any existing user with that platform ID
Game login is different: with Authentication=required it is verified upstream (routes/router/game.go:94-96, authMiddleware.go)

finding.guards_checked: Authentication mode gates only the game /login route (game.go:94-100); it is not applied to PlayFab routes. The default mode is 'disabled' (config.toml:14), which the docs state is intentional for game login, so impersonation there is expected. The finding is the PlayFab bypass in 'required' and 'cached' modes. Not checked: whether the official-server verification in game login can be bypassed by sending the same SteamID directly.

finding.claim: AwardMissionRewards trusts the client's Won flag and never checks that the mission was actually played or that it was already completed. A player can repeatedly claim gauntlet mission rewards with no battle, duplicating items.
finding.source: CloudScript FunctionParameter.Won and MissionId, from any authenticated session (the function is session-gated).
finding.sink: progressValue.Inventory = append(...) at awardMissionRewards.go:59-63 and CompletedMissions append at :51. These grant reward items and are persisted via data.DataVersion++ (:72).

trace.note: ExecuteFunction dispatches by FunctionName from the client
json.Unmarshal of client FunctionParameter into AwardMissionRewardsParameters
strings.Split(MissionId) and check elements[1]=='Gauntlet'
Only check: MissionBeingPlayedRightNow == MissionId. The attacker sets this via StartGauntletMission
StartGauntletMission sets MissionBeingPlayedRightNow to any client string; no validation
if parameters.Won: client-asserted win, not verified
Rewards appended to Inventory; no check against CompletedMissions, so this repeats

finding.guards_checked: Session required (playfabapiMiddleware.go:24-52). Mission must match the MissionBeingPlayedRightNow value, which the caller sets. The rewards amounts come from server-side labyrinth data for that user's mission, so the attacker chooses which of its own labyrinth rewards to duplicate, not arbitrary items. The field is cleared after each award, but StartGauntletMission can set it again immediately. Precondition: the user must already have challenge progress and a labyrinth (created by buildGauntletLabyrinth).

finding.claim: The RNG used for session IDs, PlayFab session tickets and cloud-file credential signatures is a PCG seeded with time.Now().UnixNano() unless a 'Deterministic' flag is set. Those tokens are therefore predictable from an approximate server start time.
finding.source: Process start time (no attacker input). An attacker who observes one token and knows the rough start window can enumerate candidate seeds.
finding.sink: Bearer tokens: game session IDs (models/session.go:22-29), PlayFab session IDs (models/playfab/session.go:82-88), cloud credential sig (models/credentials.go:13-22), and InitializeRng (rng.go:36-39).

trace.note: seed = time.Now().UnixNano() unless values.Deterministic
rand.NewPCG(seed, seed): 64-bit effective seed, non-cryptographic PRNG
session IDs generated from WithRng on sessionLetters
PlayFab session token = rand.Uint64()
cloud sig = sha256(32 rng bytes)

finding.guards_checked: No cryptographically secure RNG used for bearer tokens. The Deterministic field is read at root.go:109 but not defined in this tree, so the wall-clock path is the live one. Feasibility of the enumeration is PLAUSIBLE, not demonstrated.
